@@ output/template/.claude/tools/check-instructions.mjs ;; Instruction-structure checker; run by template-maintenance and automatically by the post-edit hook after instruction edits (read as code only).
@scope instruction-system files (CLAUDE.md, .claude/**) when the checker runs (post-edit hook or manual)

18-27 EX [x.ci-required-skills]

173-186 EX [x.ci-imports]
188-209 EX [x.ci-required-skills]

C x.ci-required-skills EX - ENFORCED ;; The checker requires every listed workflow skill (project-structure, verify, code-review, build-fix, custom-settings, git-workflow, security-scan, add-dependency, architecture-decision, template-maintenance) and knowledge skill to exist with matching frontmatter name and a description, and forbids standalone serilog/resilience skills. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system invariant (repo/meta).
C x.ci-hook-registration EX DEP-025 ENFORCED ;; Hook registrations must use exec form (command node, args [launcher placeholder, event]), a positive timeout and known handled events; PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/Stop registrations are required; only the PreToolUse guard may (and must) set onFailure block. ;; = ;; none ;; Enforcement-configuration invariant (repo/meta).
C x.ci-level-layout EX - ENFORCED ;; Rule files must live in .claude/rules/{0-core,1-architecture,2-technology,3-project}/ with a header level matching the directory. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-imports EX - ENFORCED ;; CLAUDE.md must be Level 0, its imports must resolve and it must import overview.md and decisions.md; additional imports raise a warning. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C wf010.ci-reviewer-readonly OL WF-010 ENFORCED ;; The code-reviewer agent must exist, disallow Write and Edit, and delegate to code-review/SKILL.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ci-references EX - ENFORCED ;; Internal references (backticked files, .claude paths, Depends on) must resolve; skill-private references may be used only by their owning skill (or the map); named skills/agents, routed workflows and CLAUDE.md routing targets must exist. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-no-other-models EX - ENFORCED ;; Files named like manifests, contracts, slots or capabilities under .claude/ are errors (not part of this instruction model). ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.ci-always-loaded-budget EX - ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; The always-loaded surface (CLAUDE.md, imports, model-invocable skill and agent listings) is estimated and warned above 5500 tokens. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta threshold.

@@ output/template/.editorconfig ;; Root formatting/code-style asset (applied by editors and, for IDE0005, by the build).

30-32 EX [x.ec-var-style]

40-42 EX [x.ec-braces]
44-62 EX [x.ec-naming]
64-70 OL [run024.ec-async-suffix]
71 NN ;; Comment: private-field naming follows the repository convention and is not enforced here.

C x.ec-base EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; UTF-8, final newline, trimmed trailing whitespace (not for Markdown), space indentation 4 by default and 2 for JSON/YAML/TS/HTML/CSS/JS and MSBuild/XML files. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete formatting settings beyond RUN-009.
C run024.ec-file-scoped OL RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; File-scoped namespaces reported as a suggestion. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ec-using-order EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; System directives sorted first; usings outside the namespace (suggestion). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ec-var-style EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; var when the type is apparent; explicit types for built-in types and elsewhere (suggestions). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run009.ec-suggestions-only OL RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Modern syntax preferences (pattern matching, switch expressions, collection expressions, primary constructors) are suggestions/silent only — no mechanical modernization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ec-braces EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Braces when multiline (suggestion); expression-bodied methods on single lines (silent). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ec-naming EX RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; PascalCase types and members, I-prefixed interfaces, camelCase parameters and locals (suggestions). ;; = ;; none ;; Naming rules beyond RUN-024.
C run024.ec-async-suffix OL RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Async methods require the Async suffix (suggestion). ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md ;; Agent definition (delegated reviewer).
@scope code-reviewer agent (on delegation)
1-5 IM ;; Frontmatter name and delegation description.
6 OL [wf010.reviewer-readonly]
7 IM ;; Frontmatter end.
9 NN ;; Banner.
11 NN ;; Heading.
13 OL [wf010.reviewer-readonly]
15 OL [wf010.reviewer-canonical]
16 OL [wf001.reviewer-read-owners]
17 OL [wf012.reviewer-output]

C wf010.reviewer-readonly OL WF-010 MUST_NOT ;; The code-reviewer performs an independent read-only review and does not edit files; Write, Edit and NotebookEdit are disallowed (MultiEdit and shell tools are not listed). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf010.reviewer-canonical OL WF-010 MUST ;; Read code-review/SKILL.md first and follow it as the canonical procedure; do not redefine review criteria in the agent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.reviewer-read-owners OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read CLAUDE.md and the governing rule files for the changed area; as a subagent do not assume they were loaded. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf012.reviewer-output OL WF-012,WF-010 MUST ;; Return findings in the code-review output format including important areas that could not be verified. ;; = ;; none ;;
